entries.finding: QueueLedgerStore owns canonical mutations and recovery; memory maps are projections. Constructor/backend support still must be checked before claiming persistence in all configurations.
Serial route worklist covers admitted batch only; downstream A2A uses durable message_wake and persisted causal ancestry.

Public is readable to all; user viewer sees all at this helper level; unrevealed whispers require whisperTo. Reply previews require same thread, published/nondeleted/visible parent; public replies cannot quote unrevealed whisper.

Assembler filters undelivered/display-only/briefing/legacy errors and enforces recent-first token ceiling; upstream route owns candidate/visibility selection. Collective event scope is independently checked.
Private Collective uses task workspace and fresh task context, restricted skills roots, toolExecutionPolicy, authority revalidation and abort; home-thread sharing is not universal.
Orchestrator entries, idempotency index, responses and controllers are memory Maps; first target response wins and terminal late replies are ignored.
Executable registry contains review_delivered and task_done with producer/resolver/freshness/runtime ports; readiness assertion required.

User mentions may occur anywhere; explicit current targets win. Implicit route handles ideate/concierge then previous user mention, healthy recent replier, preferred/available participant, preferred cat, default; policy may project candidates.
A2A strips fenced code, matches line-start after markdown prefixes, longest aliases with token boundaries, excludes self, max two targets; disabled aliases yield warnings. Default max chain depth 15.
Worklist is live guard projection, not executor; ancestry rebuilds depth. Ping-pong warns at 2, blocks at 4, with substantive-activity exemption; routing/hold tools are not substantive.

Structured Action callback requires services and distinct available explicit holders; ordinary-only interactive once decision creation returns immediately. This is targeted inspection, not all callback routes.
Port provides version-conflict and managed-work admission methods. The info-only SOP stage-hint claim is corroborated by route-serial, not by the port alone.
Admission resolves subject terminal state, canonical identity, return/replace, standing, predicate freshness, then claims; safe_wait may continue a fresh revision.
Completion validates active lease/generation/candidate and calls server truth resolver before recording completion; model text alone does not complete.
ArtifactReview human decision, changes_requested, reopen and new-version round are distinct domain transitions; not interchangeable with review delivery.
Replacement checks persisted identity/claim origin, predecessor return proof and verified predicate, then CAS expectedGeneration; not blind reassignment.
Evidence interface includes sourcePath/sourceHash/supersededBy/provenance/authority and summary source IDs; interface presence alone is not proof of runtime retrieval or ACL enforcement.
Redis-gated Action production wiring/boot assertion observed. Startup protects known live invocation owners; incomplete liveness snapshot preserves unknown running executions.
Specific managed Codex carrier is Darwin-only, exact codex-cli 0.159.0, native executable, policy probe and identity validation. Not a statement about every Codex execution path.
hold timer 5s-1h with structured wait source/SLA; wakeWhen exclusive; pending human input excluded. Atomic per thread/cat quota is 3/hour; new wake registered before prior retired.
Delivery, mention ACK and seen are separate cursor namespaces. Seen cannot advance delivery; configured unresolved cursor mutations fail closed.
MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Clowder AI Contributors; copies/substantial portions require copyright and permission notice. No upstream source vendored by T01.
Typed wait receipt binds invocation/source/task/user/cat/thread/generation/owner fence; predicate digest includes registered baseline; continuous tracking may omit expiry.
Authenticated retired endpoint returns 410. Decision management requires expectedRevision/operationId; settle exact strict origin user message.
Final response is an independent durable source; earlier post to same cat does not suppress explicit final mentions.
Processing slot is thread+cat; release checks exact reservation identity. Multi-target queued dispatch selects parallel mode. Full durable claim/reaper proof is outside targeted review.
Acquire stable managed-conversation policy mutex before native runtime/session mutex; resume target is re-resolved under custody; separate locks prevent concurrent native session resume.
Completed response and exact recipient wake share commit boundary; nonempty targets without wake admission throw.
Parallel independent-thinking text mentions are suppressed, with no routing/followup hint.
multi_mention MCP max 3, timeout 3-20 default 8, client-side search/override gate; Action idempotency and target-count constraints.

review Action rejected; parallel returnToPredecessor requires exactly one target; other parallel >=2 and parallelIntent. Anti-cascade. Timer and aggregate settlement are not durable; flush persists mentions:[] and no callback wake was found in inspected route.
Current HEAD review delivery evidence is checked independently of approval verdict.
ConversationDecision create/manage delegates to specialized service; no native waiter is created by this API.
Settle requires strict invocation origin user message, owner/thread match, nondeleted message after published card, live deadline, expected revision and idempotent operation.

limitations: Static targeted review does not prove runtime behavior, backend parity, crash recovery, permission enforcement end-to-end or model quality.
C12 port alone does not prove SOP info-only behavior; route-serial stage hint corroborates it.
C17 is an interface check, not retrieval/ACL runtime verification.
multi_mention reliable callback wake and timeout aggregate are not confirmed by inspected route; production behavior was not exercised.
Temporary /tmp caches may disappear; fixed source URLs and SHA256 enable refetch verification.
No upstream latest HEAD, full clone, business data, environment secrets or external model calls were used.
